decision.reason: V1 agent.plan/delegate/moa/approve are bound to V1's own loop, registry and guard. V4 provides the same capability natively (agent_delegate) with its own approval policy; running V1's second agent runtime inside V4 would duplicate state and bypass receipts.

The existing core Heartbeat engine is reused by src/v4/heartbeat.js with actual V4 goal/approval events, durable queue and shared-history/opt-in push delivery. The old tool wrapper uses V1 journal events and is not a second V4 heartbeat owner.

Self-configuration writes V1's config.json and restarts V1's agent. V4 has its own setup, doctor, owner-mode and updater. Adapting these would let the model edit the wrong configuration while appearing to manage MAJIN.

The existing core memory-sync entry point now supports canonical V2 namespaced records. V4 memory_sync uses that engine and MemoryStore with approval, folder checks and tombstones. The old wrapper assumes V1 text facts and is not used to create a shadow V4 store.
tools.search needs V1's registry.search. V4 ships tools_search/tools_activate over the live V4 registry, which also makes discovered tools callable in the next round.
Deletes artifacts measured by V1 recovery inside a shared data dir. V4 reconciles its own goals and must never run destructive V1 recovery on paths it does not own.

The V1 tool wrapper binds team.run to V1's loop and registry. Its ENGINE (src/core/teams.js: TeamStore, runTeam) and the scheduler behind it (src/core/swarm.js) are reused verbatim by V4's team_run, with V4 subagents as the worker.
